nodes.label: Payments Platform
nodes.description: The system in scope: accepts payment instructions, screens them and settles them.

nodes.label: Retail customer
nodes.description: Initiates payments from the mobile and web banking apps.

nodes.label: Correspondent bank
nodes.description: Receives outbound payments and returns confirmations.

nodes.label: Sanctions screening vendor
nodes.description: Screens every payment against sanctions lists.

nodes.label: Regulatory reporting hub
nodes.description: Receives transaction reports required by regulators.

steps.caption: A customer instructs a payment through the banking app.
Before anything moves, the platform asks the vendor to screen the parties.
The vendor returns a clear result.
The platform sends the settlement message to the correspondent bank.

scenes.title: After the fact
scenes.text: Three downstream consumers are updated without holding up the customer.

steps.caption: Accounting entries go to the general ledger.
Anything unusual is raised to payment operations.
